experiment.name: Q-SHIFT NS-4A BeliefMatching development feasibility
experiment.purpose: paired exploratory development feasibility; not confirmatory; six-condition finite-grid comparison only

generator.burst_event: simultaneous X on both data qubits after each MR boundary

allocation.allocation_rationale: Selection remains 64000 shots but is spread across all six target cells to match the equal-condition primary estimand; evaluation remains 240000. Eight roots/cell and 1333/1334 shots/root are a bounded feasibility allocation, not a power claim.
allocation.root_seed_inventory: UNALLOCATED; later collision screening and separate owner-approved freeze required before any sampling
allocation.selection_shot_schedule: 48 root-condition cells receive 1333 shots each; add one shot to roots 0-2 in each of the first four ordered conditions and roots 0-1 in the final two ordered conditions; exactly 64000 selection shots

decoder_models.selection_objective: minimum equal-condition mean of root-level LER across all six independent selection conditions; one globally fixed configuration selected
decoder_models.tie_break: model-family order in revised config, then ordinary before correlation-enabled
decoder_models.primary_pair_information: BeliefMatching and pooled-fixed PyMatching use byte-identical selected DEM and identical declared noise provenance
decoder_models.selection_uncertainty: Report all candidate scores and root-stratified bootstrap rank frequencies from selection roots; unstable rank makes the selected comparator uncertain, with no evaluation-based replacement.
decoder_models.finite_grid_scope: Strong comparator only among the 12 predeclared configurations for this finite six-cell set; not a guarantee of globally optimal fixed decoding.

primary_endpoint.name: equal-condition-weighted root-paired BM_minus_pooled_fixed_LER
primary_endpoint.formula: mean over 6 conditions of mean over 10 roots of (BM errors - pooled-selected PM errors) / shots

statistics.bootstrap_interval: two-sided percentile 95%; resample roots within condition and preserve paired arms
statistics.sign_flip: two-sided; add-one p; sensitivity only under independent roots and symmetric root-level null
secondary_holm_family: BM vs ordinary PM using selected DEM
BM vs correlation-enabled PM using selected DEM
pooled-selected PM vs nominal ordinary PM
statistics.shot_level_mcnemar: descriptive only; not primary due root clustering
statistics.practical_relative_reduction: aspirational 45-50% only; not a success threshold

progression_gate_for_review_of_larger_de.interpretation: Passing is exploratory feasibility evidence only; it authorizes no execution, confirmation, or automatic expansion and only permits a request for separate protocol review.

resource_limits_proposed.note: proposed stop limits; end-to-end pipeline has not been benchmarked

experiment.scope: Pauli composition and synthetic spatial burst; native gate/measurement rate asymmetry excluded and reserved for a separate protocol
experiment.condition_design: Six retained cells are not a complete factorial: three Pauli compositions at zero burst and three burst strengths at balanced composition; the interaction is not identified.

prohibitions: no Stage 5 or sealed evaluation access
no training or adaptive controller evaluation
no seed substitution or duplicate root on recovery

revision.scope: Pauli-composition and synthetic spatial-burst conditions only; native rate-asymmetry study separate

historical_incident_limitation: The accidental historical-outcome exposure is documented in the V2 protocol; reported non-use cannot be independently certified and influence remains unresolved.

rate_asymmetry_follow_up.status: separate future protocol; not part of NS-4A
rate_asymmetry_follow_up.note: Gate noise is applied at Clifford locations, not only data qubits; no samples or allocation proposed here.
